name: block-settings-page
summary: Sectioned settings layout with page header, section navigation, and framed sections with footers.
description: A Web block that lays out a settings page: a heading with optional actions, a section navigation that is a sticky sidebar on wide screens and a horizontal strip on phones, and one labelled card per section with an optional action footer and a danger tone for irreversible settings. Built from the Card primitives and theme tokens; forms and copy arrive through props and it fetches nothing.
use_when: a product needs an account, workspace, or organization settings page
several groups of preferences should share one page with navigation
the builder asks for a settings layout with a danger zone
